name: Giant Insect
printing: First printing, September 2024, alternate cover colophon
sourceWitness: Visually checked the first-print folio and colophon. The corrected spell page on D&D Beyond confirms the remainder of the mechanics and identifies Player’s Handbook p. 279.
errataEvidence: The first printing lists 30 HP plus 10 per spell level. Publisher errata limits the increment to levels above 4. The corrected formula is used in the encounter prose.
scopeEvidence: Base summon using the book’s three form choices.

parallelSrd.role: Independently checked the corrected rules. The SRD publication is handled by the existing standalone staged handoff.

scalableRecipeEvidence: Matched the existing Player’s Handbook recipe by publication, name, and edition. Printed prose supplies form constraints, shared caster initiative, and the effects of Web Bolt and Venomous Spew where applicable.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial comparison of the three forms. The spell summons one chosen creature per casting. Reused portrait at srd-giant-insects/portraits/giant-insect-draft.png.
habitatEvidence: The spell specifies a visible, unoccupied manifestation location in range. It gives no natural habitat for the summoned forms.

name: Mastiff
printing: March 1, 2016 release as dated on its cover
author: Greg Marks
sourceWitness: Visually checked the p. 23 Mastiff stat block and read the local original ’s patrol, kennel, and XP pages. Page labels and page numbers match.
errataEvidence: The Adventurers League FAQ’s adventure errata does not list DDEX3-14. The module’s p. 20 combat award agrees with its p. 23 Mastiff block.
appearanceEvidence: The original text describes large guard dogs without specifying their markings. The reused fawn mastiff at beast-ready-batch-02/parts/b02_06/portraits/mastiff.png provides the editorial image details.
habitatEvidence: Urban is an editorial tag for a domesticated dog at the military encampment around Yûlash’s ruins. The native range is unspecified.
